title: docs: add Publish a Model guide
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the Publish a Model integration guide
- Keeps Community Models API operations under Resources
- Covers current modalities, publishing controls, pricing, fallbacks, and health behavior
- Updates model, account, CLI, README, drawer, and generated-doc source text
- Leaves `APIDOCS.md` untouched

Tests: gen docs routes, 7/7 passed.

Merge after #13624.

gist.headline: Bring Your Own Nectar
gist.blurb: A new guide maps out how to publish a Community Model, from modalities and pricing to fallbacks and health checks. The garden has room for more pollinators.
gist.summary: Added a Publish a Model guide covering Community Model modalities, publishing controls, pricing, fallbacks, and health behavior, while keeping Community Models API operations under Resources.
gist.impact: Model providers now have a clear, current path for bringing text, image, audio, or video models to pollinations.ai and understanding how their published models behave.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly model gardener publishing labeled seed packets into a shared community greenhouse, where different code-plants represent text, image, audio, and video modalities. A CRT monitor robot can eagerly hold an open guide titled "PUBLISH A MODEL," while healthy plants, fallback watering pipes, and small Pollen price tags make the guide's controls, health behavior, and pricing legible.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm community greenhouse where the cute pixel art bee mascot has a yellow body with dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny gardener hat while placing a glowing model seed packet into a lime green (#ecf874) planter. A cute chunky CRT-monitor robot holds an open pixel guide reading "PUBLISH A MODEL," surrounded by code-plants for text, images, music, and video, with gentle watering pipes and tiny Pollen price tags; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
